consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at the Fillmore West on March 2, 1969, highlighting the intricate interplay between band members and the overall energy of the show. Many consider it one of the best performances of the year, with standout moments in several songs, particularly 'Dark Star' and 'Death Don't Have No Mercy.'
